LanguageData.VV_Command_CollectScentDesc: Target an arcane flower to collect its scent into the perfume bottle. Collecting consumes {0}x {1}, and the collected scent can be sprayed {2} times.
LanguageData.VV_Command_SprayScentDesc: Spray the scent of {0}, granting the arcane floral fragrance to every creature within {1} cells. {2} sprays remaining.
LanguageData.VV_Scent_NotEnoughPollen: Requires at least {0}x {1} to collect an arcane floral scent.
LanguageData.VV_Scent_FlowerUnreachable: The flower is forbidden, reserved, or unreachable.
LanguageData.VV_Scent_MustBeWorn: The perfume bottle must be worn to use it.
LanguageData.VV_StatsReport_FloralScent_Desc: The unique scent given off by this arcane flower. Staying in the room the flower is in, or gathering from it, grants the scent's effect. If different kinds of arcane flowers share the room, no scent takes effect.
